Invalid remote-load paths or missing SSH fixture arguments are refused before creating scratch artifacts.
limitations: Headless drivers and authority share Linux CPU and storage.
Only the native client establishes rendering performance.
Headless loopback delay and native delayed SSH forwarding are different routes.
